review.why: Earns backlinks and third-party mentions safely: confirms links are the bottleneck, picks tactics by effort, qualifies prospects and avoids link spam.
review.summary: Starts by checking whether links, not the page, explain a ranking gap using a page-level comparison. It then chooses linkable assets and ranks tactics by effort and quality, qualifies prospects, drafts outreach for approval, and sets spam-policy rules: no bought ranking links, sponsored or nofollow where paid. It also covers anchors, pace and measuring links and AI mentions.
strengths: Checks the page itself before spending on outreach
Targets pages that answer engines already cite, linked or not
Drafts outreach for approval and does not send on the user's behalf
cautions: Policy details such as dates will age
Backlink data needs a paid SEO tool for the full gap analysis
Playbooks and risk policy are in files not read here
